brief: Reduce an array to one value, from the end
description: Call callbackfn for each entry of array, from the last to the first, with the accumulator and that entry, as ECMAScript reduceRight does; each call's result is the accumulator for the next call. If initialValue is passed, it is the first accumulator and every entry is visited; otherwise the last entry is the first accumulator and the walk starts at the one before it. Undefined entries are visited. An empty array with no initialValue is an error.

parameters.description: The array to walk. A string is not walked as an array: write [...value] to walk its characters.
parameters.name: array

parameters.dataTypeParameter: (accumulator: any, value: any, index?: integer, array?: array) => any
parameters.description: Called for each entry visited; its result is the next accumulator. A script function is called with (accumulator, value, index, array); a built-in function is called with (accumulator, value).
parameters.name: callbackfn

parameters.description: The first accumulator. When it is not passed, the last entry of array is.
parameters.name: initialValue

returns.description: The last result of callbackfn, or the initial accumulator if callbackfn is not called.
